At least one acute respiratory infection.span: Influenza A occurred in 18 of 167 (10.8%) children in the vitamin D(3) group compared with 31 of 167 (18.6%) children in the placebo group [relative risk (RR), 0.58].
At least one acute respiratory infection.why: The abstract reports only antigen-confirmed influenza A, a single specific pathogen, not at least one acute respiratory infection of any cause.
